📍 FIELD SERVICES — On-Site Infrastructure & Contract Engineering

FIELD SERVICES

Premium, dependable on-site IT field dispatch for commercial businesses. When your hardware, network racks, or POS systems require physical hands, we deliver rapid contract engineering.

Service Scope Focus

We specialize strictly in commercial B2B environments, retail tech, enterprise networking, and workstation provisioning. (Note: We do not service residential clients, HVAC systems, or fiber splicing).

🔧

Hardware Deployment & Diagnostics

On-site installation, component replacement, server rack assembly, and physical workstation troubleshooting.

📡

Network & Infrastructure Setup

Switching, firewall mounting, access point (AP) deployment, patch panel punch-downs, and cable cleanup.

🖥️

Workstation & Kiosk Provisioning

Physical unboxing, desk mounting, peripheral setup, and initial domain joining for new office locations.

🔌

POS & Retail Tech Integration

Point-of-Sale terminal setup, receipt printer integration, barcode scanner configuration, and payment terminal sync.

🚨

Emergency On-Site Dispatch

Rapid response for local outage recovery, hardware failures, and urgent hands-on IT support.
